comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: The Hiking is Booming quest and its associated Himalayas discovery gives this title much sooner than any of the San Francisco quests, access to which is very lengthy (unlock permits through East Asia, begin World Atlas by charting North Sea, and talk to Mercator after EA unlock to open Northeast Passage, then again to open W. Coast of North America for SF quests). Just an interesting note. Cheers.
